title: US reaches out to Iran’s Kurds, but will they also be ‘hung out to dry’?
summary: The US has made an outreach to Iranian Kurdish dissident groups as "Operation Epic Fury" rattles the pieces of the Middle East geostrategic chess game. The Kurds in other countries have a history of being pawns in Washington’s games and have at times used their leverage to their advantage.
